title: Program for the Rescue of Entangled Marine Animals in Fisheries and Oceans Canada’s Gulf, Quebec and Maritimes regions.
description: 1. Objective: The purpose of the Program for the Rescue of Entangled Marine Animals in the Gulf, Quebec and Maritimes Regions is to maintain a ready team to safely respond to and assist or release entangled marine animals in coordination with the Campobello Whale Rescue Team, when requested by Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO). It aims to ensure the safe release of large whales and small cetaceans from commercial fishing gear, or other entangling lines, thus providing both a direct mitigation for species currently listed under the Species at Risk Act (SARA), and decreasing damage to commercial fishing gear. The Program will be during the period from April 1, 2027 to March 31, 2031. 2. Background: The Contractor is required to deliver the project in accordance with the Statement of Work ONLY in situations and conditions considered safe for such delivery. Under no circumstances should the Contractor attempt a rescue of a marine animal if environmental/weather conditions, or the logistical circumstances are not reasonable and safe given the circumstances of the disentanglement or release activity proposed. The Contractor shall monitor the environmental/weather conditions for changes that render the disentanglement or release operation no longer safe. The Contractor must adhere to any permits/authorizations/licences issued, such as, Section 38 authorization, SARA permit, as well as the Protocol for Liaison with DFO and any other protocols that may be provided by the DFO.

title: Ostolaskujen tiliöinti- ja reititysratkaisu tekoälyä hyödyntäen (Al-tiliöintipalvelu)
description: Ostolaskujen tiliöinti- ja reititysratkaisu tekoälyä hyödyntäen (Al-tiliöintipalvelu) Helsingin kaupungin asunnot Oy (Heka) pyytää tarjouksia ostolaskujen tiliöinti- ja reititysratkaisusta tekoälyä hyödyntäen (SaaS-palvelu) sekä siihen liittyvistä käyttöönotto-, koulutus- ja asiantuntijapalveluista. Hankinnan tavoitteena on tehostaa ostolaskujen käsittelyä, vähentää manuaalista työtä, parantaa tiliöintien laatua sekä nostaa automaattisen käsittelyn astetta. Tarjottavan ratkaisun tulee mahdollistaa: - ostolaskudatan analysointi ja hyödyntäminen - tiliöintiennusteiden muodostaminen lasku- ja rivitasolla - laskujen automatisoitu reititys - ratkaisun jatkuva oppiminen ja ennusteiden parantaminen käytön perusteella - käyttäjien tekemien korjausten hyödyntäminen mallien kehittämisessä - raportointi ja seuranta palvelun suorituskyvystä. Ratkaisun tulee integroitua Hekan nykyiseen ostolaskujärjestelmään DataCycle360-järjestelmän rajapintojen kautta. Hankinnassa tehdään 24 kuukauden määräaikainen sopimus, jonka jälkeen sopimuskausi jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Sopimus tulee voimaan, kun hankintasopimus on allekirjoitettu molempien osapuolten toimesta. Hankinnan tarkempi sisältö, toiminnalliset vaatimukset, integraatiovaatimukset sekä palvelutasovaatimukset on esitetty tarjouspyynnön liitteissä.,

title: Norway – Veterinary services – Procurement of veterinary duty services for Lillehammer and Gausdal municipalities.
description: The municipalities are responsible for organising clinical veterinary duty services for all animal species. The scheme with veterinary duties is established in accordance with the Act from 15 June 2001 no. 75 on veterinary surgeons and other animal health personnel § 3 a.The scheme with veterinary duties shall ensure that clinical guards are established for veterinary surgeons in all parts of the country so that the necessary veterinary help can be provided outside ordinary working hours. The veterinary duty is a necessary part of the stand-by against serious infectious animal diseases and it is important for maintaining good animal welfare.

title: Dental Imaging Equipment- CS 9600, Radiographic Units, and sensor kits
description: SCOPE OF WORK 1.0 Introduction This Statement of Work (SOW) defines the requirements of the Harry S Truman VA Medical Center - Multi-Specialty CBOC � Rolla in establishing a fixed-price order for dental imaging equipment. 1.1 Background Harry S Truman VA Medical Center - Multi-Specialty CBOC � Rolla requires dental imaging equipment to outfit the new facility and provide services for the VA. Project Contacts included: Point of Contact (POC): Activations Project Manager (PM): 1.2 Scope The scope of this purchase order is to provide Harry S Truman VA Medical Center - Multi-Specialty CBOC � Rolla with the products outlined for delivery to the Harry S Truman VA Medical Center - Multi-Specialty CBOC � Rolla location. Contractors shall furnish all requirements. The delivery schedule is based upon the current construction schedule, which is subject to change. The vendor shall not increase prices for a change in delivery date due to construction delays. The awardees� actual delivery dates will be confirmed by VA upon award. The Contractor shall provide services and support at the locations identified in this Scope of Work. The Government reserves the right to add, remove, or modify locations and facilities as mission requirements evolve across the current and future operational footprint. The Contractor shall accommodate these changes within the scope of the contract without disruption to services. Any adjustments to pricing, schedule, or resources resulting from such changes shall be addressed through the appropriate contractual modification process in accordance with the applicable Changes clause. 2.0 General Requirement All equipment to be supplied under the specifications shall be the newest and the most current model of a standard product of a manufacturer of record. A manufacturer of record is defined as a company whose main occupation is the manufacture for sale of items of equipment and which: a. Maintains a factory production line. b. Maintains a stock of replacement parts for the item. c. Maintains engineering drawings, specifications, operating manuals and maintenance manuals. d. Has published and distributed descriptive literature and equipment specifications on the equipment. Any equipment or service as applicable must be in compliance with the Memorandum dated March 6th, 2025, Subject: Electronic Health Record Modernization Standardization (VIEWS 12862405). Upon award: Field verification must be conducted and coordinated with the POC and Activations PM to ensure locations of utility boxes and all items. Shop drawings must be provided prior to installation. Activations PM will contact contractor in regards to specific delivery and installation dates to coordinate with other services. Requirements: Dental Imaging Software License Expansion - 1 X-Ray Unit, Dental, 3D: CS 9600 - 1 Radiographic Unit, Dental, Wall Mounted, 7 mA - 7 Sensor Kit, Dental Imaging System, Size 1 & Size 2 - 7 Specifications: Dental Imaging Software License Expansion: Software License must be included for 3D imaging machine to have the ability to communicate between the machine and VA computers. X-Ray Unit, Dental, 3D: Brand Name: Carestream CS 9600 The system shall be a Cone Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) imaging system capable of performing 2D panoramic, 3D CBCT, dental, oral surgery, endodontic, orthodontic, and maxillofacial applications. System shall be new, current production model. Imaging Capabilities Must provide: 2D digital panoramic imaging 3D CBCT imaging Field of View (FOV) options ranging from small, focused volumes (~5x5 cm) up to large craniofacial volumes (~16x17 cm or equivalent). High-resolution imaging with voxel sizes as small as 75-150 �m (or better). Adjustable FOV selection to limit patient radiation exposure. Metal artifact reduction (MAR) or equivalent technology. Detector & Image Quality Flat panel digital detector technology. High-contrast resolution suitable for: Implant planning Endodontic diagnosis TMJ evaluation Airway analysis Grayscale depth minimum 14-bit or equivalent. Automatic exposure control or programmable exposure settings. Software & Workflow Manufacturer-provided imaging software included. Software shall support: Implant planning tools Nerve tracing Airway measurement TMJ analysis Endodontic assessment DICOM 3.0 compliant. Integration capability with PACS and third-party practice management systems. 3D rendering and multiplanar reconstruction (MPR). Export capability in STL format for surgical guides. Patient Positioning & Ergonomics Open-face design or patient-friendly configuration. Positioning guides (minimum three planes). Adjustable chin rest, head support, and temple supports. Motorized height adjustment. Accommodates standing and seated (wheelchair accessible) patients. Touchscreen interface mounted on unit. Power: 110-240V, 50/60Hz. Compatible with standard dental operatory electrical infrastructure. Network connectivity via Ethernet Dental Radiographic units The system shall be a wall-mounted intraoral dental X-ray unit with extended reach (long arm configuration) for use in general dentistry, oral surgery, and specialty dental clinics. Imaging Performance High-frequency DC X-ray generator. Constant potential output for consistent image quality. Tube voltage approximately 60-70 kVp. Tube current approximately 7 mA (or equivalent). Exposure time range suitable for digital sensors and phosphor plates. Compatible with: Digital intraoral sensors Traditional film Rectangular collimation capability (preferred) to reduce patient dose. Focal spot size approximately 0.7 mm or smaller. Long Arm Configuration Extended arm reach minimum 81 inches (or equivalent). Double-articulating arm for flexible positioning. Smooth, drift-free positioning. Stable tube head that maintains selected position without sag. Wall-mounted installation with appropriate structural support requirements provided. Long arm shall accommodate large operatories and specialty treatment rooms. Control & Interface Wall-mounted control panel. Programmable exposure presets for: Adult anterior/posterior Pediatric anterior/posterior Digital display for exposure time. Manual exposure adjustment capability. Error codes or diagnostic display. Safety & Radiation Protection Compliance with FDA and NCRP radiation standards. Minimum total filtration equivalent to 2.5 mm aluminum at 70 kVp. Dead-man type exposure switch. Minimum source-to-skin distance compliant with federal standards. Audible and visual exposure indicators. Leakage radiation within regulatory limits. Mechanical & Ergonomic Features Lightweight tube head. 360-degree rotational capability at arm and tube head joints. Smooth, low-resistance movement. Sealed, oil-cooled X-ray tube housing. Easy-to-clean surfaces suitable for clinical infection control. Electrical Requirements Standard 110-120V electrical service. Compatible with standard dental operatory electrical infrastructure. Line voltage regulation to ensure stable output. Sensor Kit, Dental Imaging System, Size 1 & Size 2 The system shall consist of direct digital intraoral radiography sensors, Size 1 and Size 2, compatible with standard intraoral dental X-ray generators. Sensors shall be new, current production models designed for high-resolution diagnostic imaging in general dentistry and specialty dental clinics. Sensor Technology CMOS or equivalent digital sensor technology. True resolution minimum 20 line pairs/mm (or equivalent high-resolution performance). Theoretical resolution up to 24 lp/mm (or equivalent). Pixel size approximately 19-20 �m (or better). Active imaging area optimized for diagnostic accuracy. Must include: Size 1 (Pediatric/Anterior) Active area approximately 20 x 30 mm (or equivalent). Slim profile for patient comfort. Rounded corners for intraoral comfort. Size 2 (Adult/Posterior Standard) Active area approximately 26 x 36 mm (or equivalent). Standard adult posterior imaging size. Ergonomic shape for ease of positioning. Image

title: 7A--FILE360 SOFTWARE & MICROGRAPHIC HARDWARE
description: Intent to Award Notice - FILE360 SOFTWARE & MICROGRAPHIC HARDWARE The US Geological Survey (USGS) has for a new non-competitive, firm fixed price Contract for File360 Software and Modules and Micrographic EPM, Imagelink 2400 DV-Plus. The National Minerals Information Centers (NMIC), Minerals Archival and Retrieval System (MARS) provides for the archival of vital USGS minerals information data. This archival system meets the National Archives and Records Administration requirements as set by law for all Federal Agencies. Operation of MARS is dependent upon the Open Text File360, Kodak and Eastman Park Micrographics, Inc. software/hardware to perform data capture, storage, and retrieval. On-line data capability using File360 software provides ready access and flexibility for Team members to obtain minerals data from their workstations. The total anticipated period of performance will be 10/01/2026 - 09/30/2027. The USGS is aware of no other source that can provide the above. Therefore, it intends to make an award to Document Imaging Specialist, LLC/IMS unless it is contacted by any vendor who believes they have similar product that can meet the needs of this requirement. Vendors are invited to contact the Contract Specialist, Patrick Anderson via email at patrick_anderson@usgs.gov no later than 09:00 AM Eastern, Monday, September 14, 2026, with an affirmative answer.

title: Illumina DRAGEN Tier 3 Throughput License and v4 Server
description: The NHGRI Undiagnosed Diseases Program (UDP) requires both the Illumina DRAGEN 500,000Gb annual throughput license and the Illumina DRAGEN Server v4 to maintain secure, compliant, and high performance secondary analysis of next generation sequencing (NGS) data. DRAGEN serves as an essential computational supplement when UDP�s sequencing workload exceeds CIT High Performance Computing Center allocations, enabling timely processing of whole genome, whole exome, and transcriptome datasets for patients with rare and unresolved diseases. The current DRAGEN server, procured in 2017, has reached end of support. Its CentOS 7 operating system lost vendor support and security updates on June 30, 2024, increasing operational risk. In addition, the legacy dual Intel Xeon processors, 512 Gb RAM, and first generation FPGA acceleration hardware cannot support updated DRAGEN pipelines, including pangenome references and improved germline/somatic variant calling workflows. These limitations reduce analytical accuracy, throughput, and system stability. To prevent analysis delays, maintain compliance with NIH IT security requirements, and sustain mission critical genomic interpretation capacity, the UDP must acquire both the updated throughput license and the next generation DRAGEN Server v4.

description: NOTICE OF INTENT to Sole Source SOLICITATION NUMBER: 75N98026Q01114 TITLE: MRI 16 Channel Preamplifier Interface Boxes CLASSIFICATION CODE: 6525 � Imaging Equipment and Supplies: Medical, Dental, Veterinary NAICS CODE: 423450 � Medical, Dental and Hospital Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers RESPONSE DATE: September 14, 2026 PRIMARY POINT OF CONTACT: Robin Knightly, Contracting Officer Research & Development, Division A National Institutes of Health, Office of the Director robin.knightly@nih.gov PURSUANT TO FAR Subpart 5.2 � Synopses of Proposed Contract Actions, THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE OF A PROPOSED CONTRACT ACTION. THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NON-COMPETITIVE NOTICE OF INENT TO AWARD A CONTRACT OR PURCHASE ORDER WITHOUT PROVIDING FOR FULL OR OPEN COMPETITION (INCLUDING BRAND-NAME). DESCRIPTION: On behalf of the Neurophysiology Imaging Facility (NIF), the National Institutes of Health, Office of the Director, intends to solicit on a sole-source basis by a request for quotation to Rogue Research, Inc. to acquire two (2) 16-Channel Preamp Interface Boxes for Takashima Marmoset Coil on or around September 15, 2026 with an award issued on or around September 15, 2026. The purpose of this acquisition is to acquire two (2) 16-Channel Preamp Interface Boxes for Takashima Marmoset Coil for an existing Government-owned Takashima Marmoset Coil. NORTH AMERICAN INDUSTRY CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM (NAICS) CODE and SET ASIDE STATUS The intended procurement is classified under NAICS code 423450 with a Size Standard of 500 employees. This acquisition is NOT set aside for small businesses but rather is a sole-source acquisition to Rogue Research, Inc. REGULATORY AUTHORITY The resultant contract will include all applicable provisions and clauses of the Federal Acquisition Requlation (FAR) in effect through the Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01 dated March 13, 2026. STATUTORY AUTHORITY This acquisition is conducted under the authority of the Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul (RFO) Part 12� Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. For purchases not exceeding the simplified acquisition threshold, Contracting officers may solicit from one source IF the contracting officer documents that only one source is available and the basis for their decision. BACKGROUND, PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVES OF REQUIREMENT NIF operates a dedicated 7T MRI system for structural, functional, and diffusion imaging in anesthetized and awake marmosets. The three Takashima 16-channel receive arrays, acquired five years ago, have consistently produced high signal-to-noise ratio and accelerated imaging performance essential for advanced neuroimaging studies. Each receive array requires a compatible 16-channel preamplifier interface. The current inventory of two aging preamplifiers has demonstrated susceptibility to channel failure, and extended repair times have exposed vulnerability in system redundancy. Given the high utilization of the 7T MRI system by multiple laboratories, lack of available preamplifiers directly impacts scanner availability and research productivity. The objective is to establish sufficient hardware redundancy by acquiring two additional 16-channel preamplifier interface boxes to ensure continuous scanner readiness, preserve data quality standards, and sustain ongoing and future marmoset neuroimaging programs at NIF. title: Neubau Feuerwehrhaus der Stadt Rietberg - Türen, Zargen, Feuerschutztüren
description: Im Rahmen dieser Leistung sind sämtliche Innen-, Stahl- und Feuerschutztüren einschließlich der zugehörigen Stahlzargen zu liefern und betriebsfertig zu montieren. Zum Leistungsumfang gehören die Erstellung und Abstimmung einer vollständigen Türliste, die Lieferung und Montage von Stahlzargen für Mauerwerks- und Trockenbauwände sowie die Ausführung von Innentüren mit hochbeanspruchbaren HPL-beschichteten Vollspan-Türblättern für Büro-, Aufenthalts- und Funktionsbereiche. Insgesamt werden über 25 Innentüranlagen in unterschiedlichen Abmessungen sowie mehrere ein- und zweiflügelige Stahltüren ausgeführt. Darüber hinaus sind fünf T30-Feuerschutztüren mit Stahlzargen und HPL-Oberflächen sowie weitere feuerhemmende und rauchdichte Stahl-Feuerschutztüren als zugelassene Komplettsysteme zu liefern und einzubauen. Die Türen werden mit hochwertigen Edelstahlbeschlägen, Obentürschließern, Schallschutz-, Rauchschutz- und Panikfunktionen entsprechend den jeweiligen Anforderungen ausgestattet. Ergänzend sind diverse Sonderausstattungen wie Feucht- und Nassraumausführungen, absenkbare Bodendichtungen, Glasausschnitte, WC-Beschilderungen und Türschließsysteme vorzusehen. Bestandteil der Ausschreibung sind außerdem die jährliche Inspektion und Wartung aller Feuerschutztüren während der vierjährigen Gewährleistungszeit einschließlich Dokumentation und Prüfprotokollen.

title: Neubau Feuerwehrhaus der Stadt Rietberg - Fliesenarbeiten (Verlegung)
description: Die Ausschreibung umfasst ausschließlich die Verlegung und Verarbeitung der Fliesenbeläge einschließlich aller notwendigen Verlege- und Abdichtungsmaterialien. Die keramischen Wand-, Boden-, Mosaik- und Sockelfliesen werden bauseits geliefert und stehen dem Auftragnehmer zur Verarbeitung zur Verfügung. Der Auftragnehmer hat die gelieferten Fliesen innerhalb des Gebäudes an die jeweiligen Einbauorte zu vertragen, fachgerecht zu verlegen und sämtliche Verpackungsmaterialien zu entsorgen. Im Rahmen dieser Leistung sind sämtliche Abdichtungs-, Verlege- und Anschlussarbeiten für keramische Wand- und Bodenbeläge im Feuerwehrgebäude auszuführen. Die Arbeiten umfassen die Herstellung von Verbundabdichtungen gemäß DIN 18534 in Dusch-, Sanitär-, Waschhallen- und Nassbereichen, die Verlegung von Wand- und Bodenfliesen einschließlich Mosaikbelägen, Hohlkehlsockeln, Sockelfliesen sowie die Ausbildung aller erforderlichen Anschluss-, Bewegungs- und Silikonfugen. Ergänzend sind Untergrundvorbereitungen, Spachtel- und Ausgleichsarbeiten, Gerüststellungen, Ausschnitte für Installationen, Abdichtungen an Bodenabläufen und Entwässerungsrinnen sowie verschiedene Naturstein- und Bauplattenarbeiten auszuführen. Insgesamt werden rund 195 m² Wandfliesen, 694 m² Bodenfliesen, 25 m² Mosaikbeläge in Duschbereichen sowie umfangreiche Sockel-, Hohlkehlsockel-, Natursteinfensterbank- und Abdichtungsarbeiten ausgeführt. Die Leistungen beinhalten sämtliche Kleber-, Fugen- und Dichtstoffe sowie alle Nebenarbeiten zur vollständigen und gebrauchsfertigen Herstellung der Fliesenflächen.

title: Collaborative Interface and Prototyping Design Tool
description: This bid solicitation 1000439295/A cancels and supersedes previous bid solicitation number 1000439295 dated September 17, 2024 with a closing of October 16, 2024 at 02:00 PM EDT. The Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) intends to enter into a contract with a single contractor to provide 40 user licenses for a Software as a Service ( Saas) Subscription based Licenses for a cloud-based interface design and prototyping tool to support the creation, modification, and collaboration of internal and external CRA digital content, including static and interactive designs for intranet, secure portal, and Canada.ca pages. While the CRA currently uses various software design tools that are adequate for prototyping, these tools do not allow seamless collaboration among project team members. As a result, designs must often be exported into shareable formats such as PowerPoint or PDF for review by team members who do not have access to the design software. This process is time-consuming and inefficient, requiring designers to maintain multiple versions of the same file and increasing the risk that feedback provided on alternate versions may not be incorporated into the final design. The existence of multiple versions in different formats also creates potential version control issues. The CRA is therefore seeking a design and prototyping solution that enables project team members to be assigned view, comment, and edit roles, allowing them to provide feedback directly within design files without requiring individual tool licenses. This will improve sharing, collaboration, efficiency, and version control. This requirement also includes options to to acquire the additional quantities of user licenses for a Software as a Service ( Saas) Subscription based Licenses described at Annex B (see Table 3). The period of any resulting contract is a firm one-year plus the irrevocable option to extend the term of the Contract by up to 5 additional 1-year periods. A bid must comply with all requirements of the bid solicitation and meet all mandatory evaluation criteria to be declared responsive. The responsive bid with the lowest evaluated price will then be evaluated in accordance with the Proof of Proposal (POP) testing. Proposal documents and supporting information may be submitted in either English or French. The CRA reserves the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. Questions must be directed in writing to the contracting authority via email: magued.elyas@cra-arc.gc.ca Bid Submissions: Bids must be submitted by using the Connect service provided by the Canada Post Corporation. When responding, the proposal MUST be delivered to: Canada Revenue Agency Bid Receiving Unit BRUg@cra-arc.gc.ca Bids will not be accepted if emailed directly to this email address. This email address must be used to request that CRA open a Connect conversation, as detailed in Standard Instructions 2003. Bidders must not use their own licensing agreement for Connect to initiate a Connect conversation with CRA. This bid solicitation 1000439295/A cancels and supersedes previous bid solicitation number 1000439295 dated September 17, 2024 with a closing of October 16, 2024 at 02:00 PM EDT. Previously M.6.3 & M7; • Appendix 2 - Financial Proposal: The number of firm licenses required was reduced from 80 to 40 consisting of 30 Designer Licenses and 10 partner Licenses; • Annex A- Statement of Requirements: The accessibility requirements changed to use the most recent version and a new category of licenses was added. By virtue of submitting an entirely new proposal, the bidder affirms that the new proposal supersedes the previous proposal submitted by the bidder. Reciprocal Procurement - Limited Supplier Eligibility Only Canadian Suppliers and Suppliers of an applicable trading partner, as defined in the Reciprocal Procurement Declaration of Part 5 Certifications and Additional Information, are eligible for this solicitation. Bids submitted by Suppliers of a non-trading partner will be rejected. Promoting Accessibility The Accessible Canada Act (the Act) received Royal Assent on June 21, 2019, and came into force on July 11, 2019, with the goal of ensuring the full and equal participation of all persons, especially persons with disabilities, in society. This is to be achieved through the progressive realization of a Canada without barriers, on or before January 1, 2040, particularly by the identification, removal and prevention of barriers in federal jurisdiction in the following priority areas: • employment; • the built environment (buildings and public spaces); • information and communication technologies; • communication, other than information and communication technologies; • the procurement of goods, services and facilities; • the design and delivery of programs and services; and • transportation. The Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) is fully committed to the Act’s goal of making Canada barrier-free by January 1, 2040. Following consultations with persons with disabilities, their caregivers, and CRA employees with disabilities concerning the accessibility barriers they have encountered with the CRA’s service offerings, the CRA published its first-ever Accessibility Plan. The plan outlines concrete actions that the CRA will take to identify, remove and prevent accessibility barriers across its programs and services over the next three years. In keeping with the CRA’s Accessibility Plan, and in order to comply with the Act, we are taking steps to procure accessible goods and services in support of the delivery of CRA programs and services. For example, the CRA has adopted the accessibility requirements for information and communication technology (ICT) products and services as outlined in the Harmonised European Standard EN 301 549 v3.2.1 (2021-03). Compliance with this standard must be demonstrated as part of all applicable CRA ICT solicitations and resulting contracts. The CRA continues to explore ways to ensure all other goods and services procured are inclusive by design and accessible by default. As this initiative is intended to take place progressively, suppliers should anticipate that, over time, the accessibility requirements in the CRA’s procurement contracts will evolve and may become more demanding. Accessibility questions or concerns? The CRA invites suppliers to identify any accessibility concerns with this solicitation document or any of the associated requirements. Please address your concerns to the contracting authority identified in this RFP.

title: Indoor Firing Range Rental – Pacific Region Conservation and Protection (C&P)
description: 1. Advance Contract Award Notice (ACAN) An ACAN is a public notice indicating to the supplier community that a department or agency intends to award a contract for goods, services or construction to a pre-identified supplier, thereby allowing other suppliers to signal their interest in bidding, by submitting a statement of capabilities. If no supplier submits a statement of capabilities that meets the requirements set out in the ACAN, on or before the closing date stated in the ACAN, the contracting officer may then proceed with the award to the pre-identified supplier. 2. Title Indoor Firing Range Rental – Pacific Region Conservation and Protection (C&P) 3. Definition of Requirements The Department of Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) has a requirement for the services a suitable indoor firing range facility to support firearms training, qualification, and operational readiness activities for Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) Pacific Region Conservation and Protection (C&P) personnel. DFO requests the Abbotsford Fish and Game Club to provide access to an indoor firing range facility suitable for law enforcement training purposes. The Facility must support simultaneous use by multiple Officers and accommodate standard firearms training activities. The Contractor must, but not limited, to the following: A) Facility Access • Provide scheduled access to the indoor firing range for C&P personnel; • Ensure the Facility is available for bookings as coordinated with the Technical Authority; • Provide safe entry and exit procedures for all authorized personnel. B) Range Operations • Maintain the Facility in safe, clean, and operational condition; • Ensure all shooting lanes, target systems, and safety equipment are functional during scheduled use; • Provide range safety controls consistent with recognized safety standards. C) Environmental Systems • Operate and maintain an air filtration and ventilation system designed to move airflow from the firing line toward the target area; • Ensure that smoke, gases, and particulate matter from firearms discharge are effectively removed from the shooting area to maintain safe air quality. If other potential suppliers submit a statement of capabilities during the 15 calendar days posting period that meet the requirements set out in the ACAN, DFO/CCG will proceed to a full-tendering process on whether the government's electronic tendering service or through traditional means, in order to award the Contract. If no other supplier submits on or before the closing date, a statement of capabilities meeting the requirements set out in the ACAN, a Contract will be awarded to the pre-selected supplier. 4. Criteria for Assessment of the Statement of Capabilities (minimum essential requirements) Any interested supplier must demonstrate by way of a statement of capabilities that it meets the following requirements: • Operate a legally compliant indoor firing range facility; • Demonstrate experience in providing range services for law enforcement, military, or equivalent clients • Maintain appropriate insurance and certifications required for operation of an indoor firearms range; • Ensure staff are trained in range safety and emergency procedures. a) Shooting Lanes Minimum lane length of 25 meters; Minimum of 10 shooting lanes; Ability to accommodate up to 10 concurrent shooters. b) Firearms Compatibility The range must be rated and approved for: 9mm pistol ammunition (full metal jacket and hollow point); 12-gauge shotgun slug ammunition. c) Environmental Controls Air filtration and ventilation system must: Direct airflow toward the target end; Rapidly clear smoke and discharge from the firing area; Maintain air quality appropriate for prolonged indoor shooting activities. d) Lighting Conditions The Facility must provide adjustable lighting conditions, including low-light shooting capability. e) Temperature Control The Facility must be temperature controlled and capable of maintaining comfortable indoor conditions during cooler weather. f) Amenities The Facility must provide access to washroom facilities for all authorized users. 5. Trade Agreements See the description of the Posting. 6. Security Requirements This contract does not contain any security requirements. 7. Justification for the Pre-Identified Supplier The pre-identified supplier is the only supplier that we are aware of who offers a product which meets all the Minimum Essential Requirements listed above. 8. Exception to the Government Contracts Regulations The following exception(s) to the Government Contracts Regulations is (are) invoked for this procurement under subsection 6(d) – “only one person is capable of performing the work.” 9. Contract Period The Contract period will be from award to August 31, 2030 inclusive. 10. Estimated Cost The estimated value of the Contract is 216,525.00 $ CAD (excluding applicable taxes). 11. Name and Address of the Proposed Contractor Abbotsford Fish and Game Club 4161 Lakemount Road Abbotsford, BC V2T 6Z 12. The Statement of Capabilities must clearly demonstrate how the supplier meets the advertised requirements. 13. Closing Date The closing date for a submission of a Statement of Capabilities is September 14, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. EDT. 14. title: Mänttä-Vilppulan kaupungin suurkeittiö-, kylmälaitteiden huolto-, korjauspalvelut ja vuototarkastukset
description: Mänttä-Vilppulan kaupungin suurkeittiö-, kylmälaitteiden huolto-, korjauspalvelut ja vuototarkastukset Mänttä-Vilppulan kaupungin tilapalvelut hakee puitesopimuskumppaneita suurkeittiölaitteiden, sekä kylmälaitteiden huoltoon, korjaukseen ja vuototarkastuksiin. Koneiden ja laitteiden huoltojen ja korjausten toimittajaksi valitaan kolme (3) hinnaltaan edullisinta toimittajaa. Huolto- ja korjauspalveluiden tilaukset tehdään etusijajärjestyksessä. Huolto tilataan etusijajärjestyksessä 1. toimittajalta. Mikäli 1. toimittaja ei pysty palvelua toimittamaan, ostetaan palvelu 2. toimittajalta ja mikäli tämäkään toimittaja ei pysty palvelua toimittamaan, tilataan palvelu 3. toimittajalta jne. Määräaikaishuollot tehdään valitun toimijan kanssa yhteistyössä sovittujen kokonaisuuksien jaerillisen huolto-ohjeen sekä laiteluettelon mukaan 1-2 x vuodessa. Määräaikaishuollot merkitään tehdyksi huoltokirjaan sekä laitteeseen kiinnitetään tarra tai erillinen huoltotagi, mistä näkee kunkin laitteen huoltopäivämäärän. Huollon yhteydessä havaitut puutteet sekä laitteiden uusimistarpeet raportoidaan tilaajalle määräaikaishuollonyhteydessä. Mahdolliset järjestelmätäytöt ja huolto-ohjeesta poikkeavat työt laskutetaan tuntiperusteisesti. Tämän sopimuksen piiriin eivät kuulu takuuaikaiset huolto- ja korjaustyöt, jotka tekee kyseisenlaitteen toimittaja.,

This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotations are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) is 811310. The small business size standard is $12.5M. This is a total small business set aside; all responsible small business sources may submit quotations that will be considered. The contractor shall not exceed the monthly fixed-price invoicing amount without prior written authorization from the Contracting Officer. description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with FAR part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested, and a written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 36C78626Q0116 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ). This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. Quoters are responsible for obtaining all amendments or additional information concerning this announcement at Sam.gov. NORTH AMERICAN INDUSTRIAL CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM (NAICS) CODE: This acquisition is set-aside for is set aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs). The NAICS code for this procurement is 325320 � Pesticide and Other Agricultural Chemical Manufacturing. The business size standard number of employees is 1,150 Employees. This notice shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government to ultimately award a contract, nor does it restrict the Government to a particular acquisition approach. The U.S. Department of Veteran Affairs, National Cemetery Administration (NCA), anticipates the award of Firm Fixed price. This Firm Fixed Contract is for Florida National Cemetery, SW 102nd Bushnell, FL 33513. ANTICIPATED PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE: Base Year: September 21, 2026 � September 30, 2026 RESPONSE TO REQUEST FOR QUOTE (RFQ): Quotes are due to the Administrative Contracting Officer, no later than 10:00am on September 14, 2026. Responses to this announcement will result in a Firm Fixed Contract. The Government intends to make award without discussions. All information submitted in response to this announcement is voluntary and the Government will not pay for information provided nor will it compensate any respondent for any cost incurred in developing information provided for the Government. Quoters are responsible for obtaining and acknowledging all amendments or additional information concerning this announcement at SAM.gov. SOLICITATION QUESTIONS: All questions regarding this solicitation are to be submitted to the Contract Specialists via email no later than close of business, September 8, 2026. Questions pertaining to this announcement shall be sent by email to: Janice.Brooks@va.gov and copy (cc) Larry.Curtis@va.gov. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted. Associated answers to questions submitted will be provided via a solicitation amendment. If Quoter fails to endorse amendment(s), quote will be considered non-responsive and ineligible for award. INSTRUCTIONS TO QUOTERS: Interested quoters MUST be registered with the SAM at http://www.sam.gov and must compete the Online Representations and Certifications Application (ORCA) at http://www.sam.gov prior to the solicitation closing date. Failure to comply will result in the quoter being considered Non-Responsive. Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) and Veteran Owned Small Business (VOSB) socio-economic category concerns MUST have an active/current registration with https://veterans.certify.sba.gov/. Failure to comply will result in the quoter being considered Non-Responsive and ineligible for award. Interested Quoters who do not have a current/active SAM account registration or who are not certified as a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business or certified as a Veterans Owned Small Business in the SBA website (veterans.certify.sba.gov) upon solicitation close date will be considered Non-responsive and ineligible for award. All quotes are to be submitted to Administrative Contracting Officer, via email at Janice.Brooks@va.gov and copy (cc) Larry.Curtis@va.gov no later than 10:00am EST on September 14, 2026. IT IS THE RESPONSIBILITY OF THE QUOTER TO SUBMIT THEIR BEST QUOTE AT THE TIME QUOTES ARE DUE. LATE QUOTES MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED. EVALUATION PROCESS: The Government intends to award a Firm Fixed Contract resulting from this Solicitation to the responsible Quoter whose quote provides the best benefit to the Government, price and other factors considered. The following factors shall be used to evaluate quotes: Lowest Price that meets the Chemicals Salient Characteristics. title: Laboratory Mining Equipment
description: The purpose of this acquisition is to obtain the specialized laboratory equipment necessary to support PMRD�s ongoing rock?mechanics and ground?control research by ensuring the consistent preparation and testing of geological specimens aligned with rock preparations and testing standards. This includes acquiring a complete rock?specimen cutting system capable of producing accurate, repeatable cuts on rock, coal, concrete, asphalt, and core samples; a computerized grinding machine that will significantly reduce specimen preparation labor while supporting major research projects such as seismic potential forecasting and panel?well optimization; a creep test apparatus to provide essential time?dependent rock?property data for numerical modeling in coal and stone mines; and a triaxial testing machine required to determine cohesion and friction angle parameters for specimens collected from mine sites. Together, these systems will improve specimen quality, enhance laboratory efficiency, reduce the costs and delays associated with external testing, and provide high?quality mechanical data needed to support advanced modeling, pillar?design evaluations, roof?stability assessments, and the development of comprehensive databases for U.S. coal and stone mines. All equipment will be delivered to the Pittsburgh Mining Research Division facility within the established period of performance, ensuring PMRD has the necessary capabilities to meet current and future research demands.

title: Underground Storage Tank - Erie VA Medical Center
description: The Erie, PA VA Medical Center maintains multiple above ground and underground fuel storage tanks that support emergency generators, boilers, and critical utility infrastructure. Proper fuel quality is required to ensure uninterrupted facility operations during commercial power failures or natural gas service disruptions. Annual inspection, testing, cleaning, and treatment of fuel storage tanks is required to maintain compliance with NFPA 110, Joint Commission EC.02.05.07, and applicable ASTM fuel quality standards, and to ensure operational readiness of emergency power systems supporting Veteran care. The contractor shall conduct sampling, testing, filtration, treatment, and disposal necessary to inspect, clean, and restore diesel fuel storage tanks to compliant operational conditions.

Salient Characteristics are defined as containing the same active ingredient(s), and same concentrations that must be met for a chemical to be considered brand name or equal. title: PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENT OF GOVERNMENT�S INTENT TO AWARD ON A SOLE SOURCE BASIS FOR American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) subscription
description: THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR QUOTES. PURSUANT TO FAR OVERHAUL 5.101(a), THIS IS A PRESOLICITATION NOTICE OF THE GOVERNMENT�S INTENT TO ISSUE A SOLE SOURCE AWARD CONTRACT TO AMERICAN SOCIETY FOR TESTING AND MATERIALS (ASTM) FOR THEIR ASTM LICENSES The US Department of Housing and Urban Development, Office of Multi-Family Housing (MFH), intends to award a sole source contract (base year and four one-year options) to ASTM to provide subscriptions for ASTM licenses (commercial off the shelf subscription). MFH staff at headquarters and filed locations require access to ASTM standards to support the administration of its Multifamily mortgage insurance programs. The Multifamily Accelerated Processing (MAP) Guide establishes the standards and requirements used by approved lenders in the preparation and submission of applications for Federal Housing Administration (FHA) multifamily mortgage insurance. HUD staff rely on these standards to review and evaluate environmental, radon, asbestos, property condition, and related third-party reports submitted in support of Multifamily mortgage insurance applications. Because the applicable ASTM standards may be updated or revised over time, MFH staff require continued online access to current versions of the standards during contract performance. ASTM has developed and copyrighted the software. In accordance with FAR Overhaul 12.102(a), for acquisitions valued at or below the simplified acquisition threshold (SAT), the Contracting Officer has documented the determination that the circumstances of the contract action deem only one source reasonably available to procure ASTM licenses. ASTM contains a unique combination of features, tools and resources that cannot be found in any other web accessible resource available on the commercial marketplace.
